commit.message:
fix: use MCP-registered tool names across languages (#209)

* fix: use MCP-registered tool names across languages

Parse Go mcp.Tool{Name: "..."} composite literals (keyed_element/Name),
prefer explicit registration names over handler symbols, and default tools
to bare method names instead of class-qualified labels so Python, Go, and
Rust reports align (e.g. execute_shell_command).

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

* Fix nested decoy handlers in TS/JS registration object parsing

Inspect only direct descriptor fields when extracting handlers from object
arguments, unwrap inline functions without descending into nested schema
objects, and prefer explicit positional handlers over object-derived ones.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

* Rename nested decoy fixtures to match argument order

Suffixes now reflect whether the schema decoy appears before or after the
real positional handler in server.tool() calls.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

---------

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
